successCriteria.description: `resolvePreview` (src/tools/rewind.ts) builds its message list from `ctx.sessionManager.getBranch().slice().reverse()` (ROOT→LEAF) via `sessionEntryToContextMessages` — NOT from `buildContextEntries()` (the compaction-aware projection that diverges from the filter's source).

`indexToEntryId[i]` === the source `SessionEntry.id` of `messages[i]`, pushed in the SAME loop that builds `messages` (the inverse-map invariant that makes the pin resolvable by S4's `mapEntryIdsToMessageIndices`).

`hideEntryIds = remove.map(i => indexToEntryId[i]).filter((id): id is string => typeof id === 'string' && id.length > 0)` is computed from the resolved `remove` set and returned alongside `{ ledger, k }` (widened return shape).

`rewindExecute` step 7 OMITS `hideEntryIds` from the `RewindMarkerInput` payload when the array is empty (conditional spread → the key is `undefined`/absent on the persisted marker, NOT `[]`) — so S4's live-fallback path is exercised for empty/legacy markers.

Capture failure (resolvePreview throws, including when `getBranch()` is unavailable or throws on a minimal mock) NEVER blocks the rewind: `rewindExecute` step 5's existing try/catch falls back to `hideEntryIds: []` (omitted) + empty ledger + K=0, and the tool STILL returns a success result (E13/E8).

A marker created against a known-id fixture branch carries the resolved toolGroup's source `SessionEntry.id`s in `data.hideEntryIds` (asserted via the existing `makePi()` `appendEntry` spy with `expect.arrayContaining`), and does NOT include the ids of messages outside the resolved removal set.
When the resolved `remove` set is empty (nothing to hide) OR `getBranch()` throws, the persisted marker's `data.hideEntryIds` is `undefined` (omitted), not `[]`.

The existing 29 tests in test/tools/rewind.test.ts stay GREEN after migrating their fakes from `makeCtx({ contextEntries: [<root→leaf>] })` to `makeCtx({ branch: [<leaf→root>] })` — proving the source switch preserves K/ledger/refusal/details behavior.
